preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= M <= 10**6 and 0 <= N <= 10**6 for M, N in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, M and N are between 0 and 10^6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(''.join(s).isalpha() and ''.join(s).replace('R', '').replace('K', '') == '' for s in strings)
preconditions.description: Each string consists only of characters 'R' and 'K'.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 10**6 for s in strings)
preconditions.description: The length of each string does not exceed 10^6 characters.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, tuple) and len(result) == 2 for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result is a tuple of two integers.

postconditions.expression: all(result[0] == sum(1 for i in range(len(s)) for j in range(i+1, len(s)+1) if ''.join(s[i:j]).count('R') == M) for (M, N, s), result in zip(test_cases, results))
postconditions.description: The first integer in each result is the number of substrings containing exactly M characters 'R'.

postconditions.expression: all(result[1] == sum(1 for i in range(len(s)) for j in range(i+1, len(s)+1) if ''.join(s[i:j]).count('K') == N) for (M, N, s), result in zip(test_cases, results))
postconditions.description: The second integer in each result is the number of substrings containing exactly N characters 'K'.
